subject.title: feat: show Codex transcripts in the sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw expose full persisted Codex transcript items in the normal Control UI sidebar across opted-in paired computers using Codex's experimental `thread/turns/list` API?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but making full persisted transcript content part of the primary cross-computer UI is a product and privacy-boundary choice that automated correctness review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve bounded read-only access
options.body: Resolve the merge conflict and land the current bounded, authenticated design while keeping continue and archive operations on the owning computer.

options.title: Restrict reads to the Gateway host
options.body: Retain sidebar transcript viewing only for local Codex sessions until paired-node content exposure is separately approved.

options.title: Keep metadata-only supervision
options.body: Defer transcript content entirely until the upstream API and long-term privacy policy are considered stable.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded read-only access
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge conflict and land the current bounded, authenticated design while keeping continue and archive operations on the owning computer.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history ties this person most directly to the current Codex supervision product boundary and implementation.
